from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-c16c9305.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda value: sum(cell == value for row in grid for cell in row))
    foreground = [value for value in colors if value != background]
    if len(foreground) != 1:
        return out
    marker = foreground[0]
    for row in out:
        for col in range(len(row) - 2):
            if row[col] == marker and row[col + 1] == background and row[col + 2] == marker:
                row[col + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
